page.overview:
What is Mabosstiff?

Mabosstiff is a large dog Pokémon. It has thick, gray eyebrows, black eyes with an orange sclera and nose. Most of its fur is brown, but it also has black and gray fur.

Mabosstiff loves playing with children and is very gentle and kind with its friends and family. However, if they become threatened, it snarls at it's enemies to intimidate them from attacking. If this fails, it unleashes the energy stored in its dewlap to blow them away.

Mabosstiff is the only pokemon with the unique ability Guard Dog.

Mabosstiff evolves from Maschiff starting at level 30.
